scope: Fifth bounded target-specific wave: 12 independently researched direct material matches, with no inherited family credit.

methodology.credit_rule: Only target-specific official repositories pinned to immutable commits and exact source loci proving a material same-target slice receive verified credit.
methodology.licence_rule: Only the pinned GPL-3.0 ERPNext and AGPL-3.0 FleetOps community source is credited; hosted services and private extensions are excluded.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layout.
methodology.runtime_boundary: No application tests, browsers, databases, queues, jobs, deployments, Git history or product state were changed for this research wave.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authorised asset manager can calculate scheduled depreciation for eligible fixed assets at an effective date, post balanced accounting entries, link those entries to the schedule, and update the asset's book status.

benchmark.proven_slice: Creates and regenerates asset depreciation schedules, selects eligible due rows, posts linked debit and credit journal entries, and refreshes asset status.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion calculation methods, organisation scope, permissions, retry UX, audit display or runtime results.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned community source only; hosted and private extensions excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authorised asset manager can sell or scrap an eligible fixed asset on a valid effective date, account for depreciation and disposal gain or loss, persist the disposal state and date, and support reversal or restoration.

benchmark.proven_slice: Validates sale and scrap eligibility, depreciates to disposal date, records sold status, posts disposal journals and calculates gain or loss.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion's single disposal form, exact proceeds fields, authorisation, provenance or runtime recovery.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned community source only; hosted and private extensions excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Authorised users can maintain and inspect fixed-asset identity, purchase, category, location, depreciation and current-book-value information in a filterable register.

benchmark.proven_slice: Persists fixed-asset identity, purchase, location, ownership, depreciation and status fields and produces a filtered register with cost and current value.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion linked operational data, NZ account choices, authorisation, site scope or runtime acceptance.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned community source only; hosted and private extensions excluded.

benchmark.proven_slice: Runs a payable-mode outstanding-invoice engine and allocates supplier balances into configurable ageing ranges.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion report layout, default buckets, scope, ledger equivalence, exports, permissions or runtime correctness.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned community source only; hosted and private extensions excluded.
